topics.name: Runtime Capability Resolution
topics.purpose: Define command/operation capability availability separately from invocation authority, including disabled/missing dependency states and explicit remediation.

semantics.capability_rule: Command may require one or more explicit runtime capabilities/modules/services.
semantics.availability_rule: Capability availability is resolved from boot/profile/registry state.
semantics.authorization_rule: Available capability does not imply caller authorization.
semantics.dependency_rule: Missing capability/dependency is never silently auto-enabled.
semantics.remediation_rule: Failure reports exact missing/disabled capability and one concise actionable remediation where deterministically known.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional capability branches are explicit and do not alter required command semantics silently.

invariants.rule: Executable commands resolve by exact canonical identity and schema, cross one governed dispatcher boundary, and never infer authority from capability presence or parser success.

hard_gates.condition: required capability missing but dispatch continues

references.purpose: Capabilities resolve from explicit boot/dependency state.
